name: How do open houses or showings impact the likelihood of a bidding war?

mainEntity.name: How do open houses or showings impact the likelihood of a bidding war?

acceptedAnswer.text: Well-executed open houses and private showings are crucial for generating excitement and interest, which can significantly contribute to a bidding war. Creating a sense of urgency and high demand among potential buyers by having multiple viewings scheduled closely together can be very effective. A strategic showing schedule ensures maximum exposure, allowing more buyers to see the home and potentially submit an offer, increasing the competitive atmosphere.
acceptedAnswer.description: Effective open houses and showings create urgency and exposure, attracting multiple buyers and increasing the chances of a bidding war.
